part.text: Fixed. In `model/labels/labels.go:353`, `DropMetricName` was mutating the shared backing array via `append(ls[:i], ls[i+1:]...)`. Changed to `append(ls[:i:i], ls[i+1:]...)` — the full slice expression limits capacity, forcing `append` to allocate a new slice instead of overwriting labels shared with the original series. `TestLabels_DropMetricName`, `TestRangeQuery`, and the full `model/labels` and `promql` test suites all pass.
